evidence.status: directly_supported proposal boundary after root reclassification
directly_supported chronology and evaluation constraints after root reclassification

purpose: Test the single surviving internal COST5-SPO+ hypothesis using only the frozen four saved actions plus their fixed champion action, but fail closed before any fit or score if those saved actions cannot prove strict D-1 14:00 label/selection chronology.

hard_input_gate.G0a: For each Q3/Q4 base action, maximum target-label availability used in fitting must be strictly earlier than the first held operating-day basis time.
hard_input_gate.G0b: Every feature, iteration, policy, blend, threshold and weight selection timestamp must be strictly earlier than that held basis; same-fold or future-fold selection fails.
hard_input_gate.G0c: Assessment retains only complete common operating-day atoms with 72 unique group-hour cells; exclusions are mechanical and disclosed.
hard_input_gate.G0d: All declared input hashes match; no 2024, test, rejected ECMWF, Dacon or remote-inference input.
hard_input_gate.failure_action: STOP before decision-model fit, official metric call, bootstrap, score-bearing closure, or comparison-index consumption; close REFUTED non-score-bearing.

conditional_procedure_if_G0_passes.policy_selection: Select each base action fixed (T,G) only on complete Q2 operating days whose labels are available before the Q3 first basis; freeze through Q3/Q4.
conditional_procedure_if_G0_passes.outer_rule: Q2 burn-in; train COST5 on label-available past only for Q3; expand through label-available Q3 past only for Q4.
conditional_procedure_if_G0_passes.feature_map: Frozen S16-N3 state/action map, adding normalized CHAMPION action; fold-local finite imputation and standardization fitted on training rows only.
conditional_procedure_if_G0_passes.cost: Exact official per-row additive loss contribution scaled by the fold training-row count, with invalid actual<0.1*capacity rows assigned zero contribution exactly as the official metric.
conditional_procedure_if_G0_passes.learner: Five-action linear SPO+ empirical-risk minimizer; zero initialization; L2 lambda=0.001; scipy L-BFGS-B; maxiter=500; ftol=1e-12; gtol=1e-7; deterministic argmax/argmin tie break by declared action order; no sweep or retry.
conditional_procedure_if_G0_passes.candidate_output: Choose the minimum predicted-cost action per row; no blending, calibration, threshold, seed search, or fallback chosen from assessment scores.

evaluation.promotion: S17-N3 stable-all-block gate; Q3 and Q4 deltas positive; exact/additive sign agreement; candidate in 90% MCS and incumbent excluded.
evaluation.label: retrospective_chronology_repaired_multiplicity_aware_not_fresh_holdout

pass_label: SUPPORTED only if G0 and full S17-N3 promotion gate pass; otherwise REFUTED or INCONCLUSIVE in stated scope
